title: Why Do We Need Bones?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Need Bones.
They protect the brain and heart.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Muscles pull on bones so you can move.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Milk, greens, and play help bones grow strong.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Bones are your inner scaffolding.
The pictures today are a new bone world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we need bones.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
